strongest_angle: The newly deciphered red pocket travel diary of Harry Houdini, spanning from 1897 to 1899 and published from Dr. Bruce Averbook's collection, details his early turn-of-the-century struggles in dime museums and the crucial partnership with his wife Bess.

key_facts.fact: Harry Houdini's earliest known travel diary spans two full years from 1897 to 1899 and documents his formative experiences in dime museums, medicine shows, circuses, and early vaudeville, according to collector Dr. Bruce Averbook.

National Geographic published an article by Nina Strochlic on October 28, 2026, detailing Harry Houdini's little red pocket diary and the key role of his wife Bess in his rise to international stardom.
Dr. Bruce Averbook's collection includes the earliest known travel diary of Harry Houdini, published in the book Escaping Obscurity: The Travel Diary of Harry Houdini, 1897-1899.
